data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Miscellaneous systemic drugs_

**Class:** Aqueous extract of human placenta (biogenic stimulator; e.g. Placentrex)

## Mechanism of action
- Contains nucleotides, peptides, enzymes and growth factors claimed to stimulate wound healing, melanogenesis and tissue regeneration (mechanism not well established)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Indian practice: chronic non-healing ulcers, burns, post-procedure healing (gel); vitiligo (older topical preparations — weak evidence); periodontitis, pelvic inflammatory disease (injection — historic)

## Dose & formulations
- Injection 2 mL IM daily or alternate days (as per product); gel applied once or twice daily to wounds

## Adverse effects
- Injection-site pain, allergic reactions; theoretical risk of transmissible infection (human-derived)

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid (insufficient data).

## Viva points
- Indian biogenic product; evidence is weak — mention as an adjunct only

_Sources: Khopkar (Placental extract). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
